jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
Specialist - Product Owner - IN
The role act as liaisons between different stakeholders, including engineering, operations, and business to execute product strategy. They maintain and manage the product backlog, or the prioritized list of requirements for future product development.

Key Responsibilities and Duties - Incumbents in this role may also be responsible for modernization and integration efforts.

- Product Owners work very closely with Product Managers to create user stories.

- They author documents relating to product life cycle including product roadmap, business requirements and functional specifications.

- They participate in sprint planning, perform market research and competitive analysis leading to the iterative development of the product.

jobs.title: Experience Product Manager
jobs.description:
This is a Non-Employee Contingent Worker Role providing services for TIAA’s family of companies and will be employed by TIAA's preferred 3rd Party Supplier. As a Non-Employee CW, perform a variety of moderately complex business planning, support, and project-related duties. Demonstrates an exceptional standard of quality and holds themselves accountable to achieving excellent results.

This role will sit onsite, likely in a hybrid capacity, at the location(s) listed in this posting.

The anticipated term of this engagement will be 12 months. This term could be extended based on company business needs.

Product Management
The Product Management role is responsible for managing aspects of the product strategy and the end-to-end product lifecycle. This job reviews and assesses market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor activity to identify market opportunities for the products.

Key Responsibilities and Duties
- Coordinates with partners across the enterprise to deliver product strategy and ensure accurate and cohesive operations, promotion, and distribution of the product.
- Conducts research on product trends and positioning strategies, analyzes consumer behavior and develops insights on market conditions to inform the product strategy.
- Produces reports on profitability and performance and fosters discussions around business expectations, market dynamics, and customer preferences.
- Monitors various metrics and market dynamics and measures product performance against business expectations.
- Coordinates strategic processes for the product and ensures partnership alignment on decisions related to the product lifecycle.
- Partners with legal, risk and compliance teams to fully identify, understand, establish controls, test and mitigate potential risks to ensure products adhere to compliance, privacy regulations and policies.
- Acts as product subject matter expert on features and services.

Educational Requirements
- University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience
- 3+ Years Required; 5+ Years Preferred

Career Level
7IC

Product Management
The Product Management role is responsible for managing aspects of the product strategy and the end-to-end product lifecycle. This role focuses on TIAA's forms modernization effort, moving from a paper-based platform to a digital-first solution that helps customers find the right form instantly, provides real-time validation, and enables straight-through processing. This job reviews and assesses market trends, consumer behavior, and operational data to identify opportunities to simplify, digitize, or eliminate forms.

Key Responsibilities and Duties
- Coordinates with partners across the enterprise to deliver product strategy and ensure accurate and cohesive operations, promotion, and delivery.
- Conducts research on product trends and positioning strategies, analyzes consumer behavior and form-completion patterns, and develops insights on market conditions to inform strategy.
- Produces reports on performance, error reduction, and cost impact, and fosters discussions around business expectations, market dynamics, and customer preferences.
- Establishes and maintains control over the forms inventory, and develops a clear point of view on which forms should be simplified, digitized, or eliminated within each delivery cycle.
- Monitors various metrics and market dynamics and measures performance against business expectations.
- Coordinates strategic processes and ensures partnership alignment on decisions related to the product lifecycle.
- Partners with legal, risk, and compliance teams to fully identify, understand, establish controls, test, and mitigate potential risks to ensure products adhere to compliance, privacy regulations, and policies.
- Acts as subject matter expert on product features and services.

Related Skills

Accountability, Go-To-Market, Product Management, Project Management, Resiliency, Strategic Thinking

jobs.title: Director - Product Manager - Lakehouse (Asset Management)
jobs.description:
Overview of the Role

Nuveen is seeking a seasoned leader with 15+ years of experience to own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of our enterprise Data Lakehouse. This is a leadership role as product manager leading team of product owners across platform and engineering , ideal for someone who has evolved from a technical or engineering background into product/platform leadership, or who has spent a career building and scaling data platforms in complex, regulated environments. The successful candidate will have deep credibility with both engineering teams and senior business stakeholders, a track record of building platforms and the organizational maturity to navigate competing priorities across multiple lines of business.

Key Responsibilities of the Role
- Own the multi-year vision and strategy for the Data Lakehouse, positioning it as foundational infrastructure for the enterprise's data and AI ambitions
- Present platform strategy, investment needs, and progress directly to senior leadership and executive stakeholders, securing sustained funding and organizational buy-in
- Own the full business case and ROI narrative for platform investment, including build-vs-buy decisions and multi-year cost/benefit tradeoffs
- Anticipate industry and technology shifts (cloud data platform evolution, AI/ML convergence with data infrastructure, emerging AWS capabilities) and translate them into forward-looking roadmap decisions
- Represent the platform in enterprise architecture governance forums, ensuring alignment with broader technology strategy
- Serve as the senior-most point of accountability between the platform organization and business/data consumer stakeholders across all lines of business
- Negotiate and arbitrate competing priorities across business units with differing platform needs, making final prioritization decisions
- Build strong partnerships with enterprise data governance, security, risk, and compliance functions to ensure the platform meets regulatory and audit expectations
- Define platform success metrics at the organizational level (adoption across business units, cost efficiency, reliability, time-to-value for new use cases) and hold the organization accountable to them
- Lead post-incident reviews and systemic root-cause analysis for major platform issues, driving structural improvements
- Continuously benchmark the platform against industry best practices and competitor/peer capabilities, driving modernization initiative

Educational Requirements
- University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience
- 15+ Years Required;

Physical Requirements
- Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level
10PL

Required Experience & Qualifications:
- Domain : Asset Management Technology (Key words – Data Lakehouse, Data Product Ownership , Product Manager, Cross-Functional Leadership, Roadmap Ownership, Product Strategy, Data Lake, Lakehouse Architecture, Data Platform, Enterprise Data Platform, Data Mesh, Modern Data Stack, Data Infrastructure )
- Extensive experience in financial services, asset management, or investment management, with a clear understanding of the regulatory, risk, and audit context these industries carry
- Familiarity with the range of platform consumers typical in this domain — quants, risk teams, reporting/BI, data science, and downstream application teams — and their differing needs from the platform

- Experience with AI/ML platform integration (SageMaker, Bedrock) and how generative AI and agentic architectures are converging with data lakehouse platforms
- Prior experience standing up a lakehouse or modern data platform from a legacy or fragmented state, rather than only maintaining a mature one
- Experience with FinOps/cost optimization practices for large-scale cloud data platforms
- Commercially astute: quickly recognizes the different levers to pull to drive growth and increase productivity
- Strategic in nature, with a strong bias towards transformation and execution

- Stimulates action with a balanced leadership style of control and influence
- Decisive and operates with a sense of urgency

- Program, risk, and change management experience
- Agile proficient

Related Skills

Continuous Integration and Deployment, Debugging, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Problem Solving, Programming, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle, Software Testing, Systems Design/Analysis, Systems Development Life Cycle _____________________________________________________________________________________________________

jobs.title: Associate Director - Product Management
jobs.description:
Expert - Product Management - IN
The role is responsible for the ongoing management and promotion of a product or family of products at all stages of the product lifecycle - market and requirements analysis, defining product concept, product development, product launch and the ongoing management of the product post launch.

Key Responsibilities and Duties - They work with cross-functional and cross-organizational teams to identify, prioritize, and design solutions for business requirements.

- Primary responsibilities include working with the development team to determine product functionality and with the sales & marketing team to strategize product positioning, product pricing and drive the product launch.

- The professionals are also required to conduct external and internal trainings on the product and are required to deliver product presentations and webcasts to clients for specialized topics.

- The professionals need to have in depth knowledge on the domain of the vertical, should be strong on project/program management and also should have excellent communication skills and client management skills.

Educational Requirements - University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience - 5+ Years Required; 7+ Years Preferred

The ideal candidate will bring strong capital markets domain expertise combined with proven stakeholder management skills across portfolio managers, compliance and risk teams, operations, and technology groups.
This role requires excellent communication skills to effectively translate between business and technical language, the ability to balance competing priorities across multiple departments, and strong negotiation skills to build alignment among diverse stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Senior Business Analyst programs and configures software to business needs. Under limited supervision, this job identifies and analyzes business software needs, writes complex code to optimize the performance and efficiency of the organization's information technology (IT) platform and infrastructure and conducts testing to ensure programs are functioning properly. This job is considered a subject matter expert in the applications development and support area.

Key Responsibilities and Duties - Interprets written business requirements and technical specification documents to design and develop advanced technical solutions that meet business needs in financial industry.

- CCollaborates with information technology (IT) and business partners to design, develop, and troubleshoot end-to-end technical solutions.

- Performs complex coding based on written technical specifications.

- Tests the resulting coding components in accordance with company standards and as defined in approved testing plans.

- Investigates, analyzes and documents reported defects; raises issues as appropriate.

- Analyzes run time profiles to debug errors that may exist and performs maintenance programming and correction of identified defects.

- Solves complex defects that arise through own work or the work of others.

- Manages large application development and software processes, along with guiding and mentoring lower level professionals.

Educational Requirements - University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience - 5+ Years Required; 7+ Years Preferred

Physical Requirements - Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level
8IC

AI Product Owner
Job Description
Experience:  8–15 years in technology/product roles, with demonstrated Product Owner or Business Analysis experience in AI-driven or automation initiatives
Location:  Pune
Reports To:  Mrinalini Kulkarni
Role Summary
We're looking for an AI Product Owner to drive the definition, prioritization, and delivery of AI-enabled product capabilities. This role bridges business stakeholders and engineering/data science teams, translating complex, ambiguous requirements into clear, actionable user stories that drive value delivery.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end requirement gathering through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs
- Manage relationships across business, technology, compliance, and vendor stakeholders; align competing priorities into a coherent product roadmap
- Author clear, structured requirement documentation (BRDs, functional specs, process flows)
- Translate high-level business requirements into detailed, sprint-ready user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria
- Own and prioritize the product backlog; partner with Scrum teams through sprint planning, grooming, and UAT
- Define and validate acceptance criteria in collaboration with QA and engineering
- Evaluate AI/ML and automation use cases for feasibility, business value, and risk (model accuracy, data quality, explainability, compliance)
- Partner with data science/engineering teams to define training data needs, evaluation metrics, and success criteria for AI features
- Drive UAT planning, execution, and sign-off with business stakeholders
- Monitor post-launch performance and iterate based on user feedback and product metrics

Required Qualifications
- 8–15 years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Program Management within technology-driven environments
- Strong hands-on experience with requirement gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management across cross-functional teams
- Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into detailed user stories and acceptance criteria
- Working knowledge of AI/ML product concepts (LLMs, agentic workflows, automation platforms) — technical depth not required, but fluency in AI product trade-offs is expected
- Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent)
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in Asset Management or broader financial services domain
- Exposure to automation platforms (e.g., Unqork, Automation Anywhere) or AI agent/LLM-based tooling
- Certifications such as CSPO, POPM

Related Skills

Agile Methodology, Continuous Integration and Deployment, Data Analysis, Debugging, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Operating Systems Management, Problem Solving, Programming, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle, Web Application Development _____________________________________________________________________________________________________
